Subject: Supplier ops intake — PO requirements & line-item field mapping

Hi Elena / Bluepoint team —

Thanks for partnering with us on the onboarding work for the pilot deal (BP-4852). To avoid last-minute billing friction, we'd like to confirm a few procurement details and share our suggested mapping for PO line items. High-level asks:

- Please confirm whether Bluepoint requires a fully executed PO before the first invoice, or if you allow invoice submission during vendor setup for trial periods.
- Can you confirm the preferred delivery for PO numbers on invoices (PDF, EDI, or a PO field in the invoice body)?
- We’ve attached a draft field-mapping workbook (Redwood_PO_FieldMap_v2.xlsx) — can you review and mark any fields you need (e.g., GL code, cost center, department)?
- Please send your vendor setup form and remit/contact details (W-9/tax id, remit address, payment terms).
- For line items: we typically surface cloud usage as aggregated month-line items and professional services as itemized deliverables. Do you prefer aggregated monthly lines for recurring charges or per-SKU lines?

Proposed next steps:
1) Bluepoint returns vendor setup form + list of mandatory PO fields
2) We complete and return final field map + sample invoice line-item CSV
3) Bluepoint confirms vendor setup lead time and PO issuance timeline

I’ve cc’d Marissa and Dev from finance/ops — they’ll own the field mapping and GL questions. Let me know if you’d prefer a 30-minute call to walk the mapping.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Program Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_PO_FieldMap_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@bluepoint.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: vendor-ops@bluepoint.com
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 14:35:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Supplier ops intake — PO requirements & line-item field mapping

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the clear outline. Quick answers and next steps from Bluepoint Procurement: 

- PO requirement: We do require a PO number to be on the invoice for all paid engagements. For proof-of-concept/trial credits we can accept invoices without a PO but please flag those as "trial" when submitting.
- PO delivery: PDF invoices with a visible PO number are fine; we can also ingest EDI if your AR team prefers automated processing.
- Vendor setup: Please provide your legal entity name, EIN/TAX ID, remit address and a signed W-9. Once we receive the completed vendor form we typically activate vendors in 3–7 business days.
- Line-item preference: For cloud usage we prefer one aggregated monthly line per subscription (unit = month, quantity = months billed). For professional services we need line-level granularity (task description, start/end date, hours, rate).

I attached our vendor intake form (Bluepoint_Vendor_Setup_Form.docx) and an example PO (PO-2109-Bluepoint.pdf) so you can see how fields map on our side.

A couple of clarifying Qs for your team:
1) Do you have a remit-to address that differs from the legal address?
2) Do you require a specific GL code on our PO to route to your finance system?

If you want, we can accept the completed form by EOD tomorrow to meet your go-live target.

Best,
Elena Ramos
Vendor Operations Manager
Bluepoint Analytics
Attachments: Bluepoint_Vendor_Setup_Form.docx; PO-2109-Bluepoint.pdf
